items.headline: Extreme Heat Warning issued September 10 at 12:32PM PDT until September 10 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerously hot conditions with high temperatures in the 80s
at the beaches to the mid to upper 90s along higher coastal terrain
expected.

* WHERE...Orange County Coastal Areas and San Diego County Coastal
Areas.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM PDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Heat related illnesses increase significantly during
extreme heat events.
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.
